summary: The committed panels clearly show the claimed chord geometry and representative-plane selection for two isolated tracks, but the evidence is deliberately restricted to clean, unbranched, non-warning objects. It does not cover the required faint, bright, curved, short, long, touching, irregular, merged, split, leakage, or unavailable-width cases. This unrepresentative visual evidence blocks acceptance of the high-risk claim.

findings.title: Visual evidence is intentionally restricted to clean, morphology-normal examples
findings.impact: The evidence cannot establish that the primary width remains truthful for the required difficult objects or reveal how touching objects, irregular centerlines, segmentation leakage, merges, splits, faint signal, and insufficient chord sampling affect the measurement. Because visual-evidence review is required for this high-risk claim, acceptance is blocked.
evidence: scripts/generate_v571_body_width_evidence.py:101-110 excludes branched objects, morphology-warning objects, low-ratio objects, and objects outside a narrow area range from selection.
audits/evidence/v571_body_width_final/body_width_visual_evidence_manifest.json:12-89 contains only one KJ and one WT track.
Direct inspection of the four manifest-listed PNGs shows two isolated, bright, similarly elongated objects and no labeled adversarial or failure example.
findings.recommendation: Generate a superseding commit-bound evidence set with object-level raw/probability/mask/boundary/centerline/chord/final-overlay panels for faint, bright, curved, short, long, touching, and irregular objects. Include missed, merged, false-split, leakage, cropped, and insufficient-chord cases, with explicit adjudication and unavailable width where applicable.

findings.title: Surrounding detections and instance separation are not auditable
findings.impact: Nearby raw and probability-map objects are visible, but only the selected target mask is displayed. Missed nuclei, neighbor merges, false splits, and boundary assignment errors could therefore go unnoticed even when the target chord overlay appears plausible.
evidence: scripts/generate_v571_body_width_evidence.py:249-261 reduces the filled-mask panel to the selected instance label.

Direct inspection of KJ-01_track1299_selected_width.png and WT-01_track1535_selected_width.png shows surrounding objects in raw/probability panels without corresponding complete instance-boundary or identity overlays.
findings.recommendation: Add a full-instance-label panel and final overlay for the identical crop, with persistent identities and explicit target highlighting, so every nearby supported object and boundary assignment can be reconciled.

limitations: No full image stack or expensive inference was run, as instructed.
External raw microscopy paths recorded at audits/evidence/v571_body_width_final/body_width_visual_evidence_manifest.json:33-48 and :71-86 were not independently reopened.
PowerShell constrained language prevented independent Get-FileHash recomputation; artifact paths and recorded hashes were inspected from the committed manifest.
The visual review establishes overlay readability and internal consistency, not biological ground truth or PSF-corrected physical diameter.
recommended_follow_up: Replace clean-track-only selection with a prespecified stratified visual sample spanning every required intensity, shape, contact, and failure category.
Show all instance boundaries and identities in each crop, not only the selected target mask.
Include at least one insufficient-chord example demonstrating that the overlay and retained output both report width as unavailable.
Run a new append-only visual-evidence audit after the expanded artifacts and manifest are committed.
